properties.project_name: Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 at 675 Nelson Rising Lane alone is ~13 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: 161,757 sq ft plus 20,000 sq ft of vivarium space, five stories, two interlocking L-shaped wings (wet labs and PI/fellow offices). Architect Rafael Viñoly Architects. Broke ground 2006; grand opening June 2009, per UCSF's own press release.
